sentence: Clicking an HTML anchor link that points to a spot inside the same tiddler keeps that tiddler on screen and does not open another tiddler.
setup: In the sidebar on the right side of the page, click the plus icon button (its tooltip says 'Create a new tiddler'). An edit form opens with a title box that says 'New Tiddler'. Leave the title as it is. Click inside the large empty text area below the title and tags and type exactly this on one line: Jump to spot and Landing place . Then click the tick (checkmark) button at the top right of that edit form (its tooltip says 'Confirm changes to this tiddler'). Scroll to the tiddler titled 'New Tiddler' if it is not in view.
ready: A tiddler titled 'New Tiddler' is shown, not in edit mode, with the link 'Jump to spot' followed by the text 'and Landing place'.
action: In the body of the tiddler titled 'New Tiddler', click the link 'Jump to spot' once. Wait 2 seconds. Do not scroll or click anything else.
broken: A tiddler with the title 'my-spot' is shown in the main area, with a message that the tiddler 'my-spot' is missing.
working: The text 'Landing place' is shown in the main area, and no tiddler titled 'my-spot' and no message about a missing tiddler 'my-spot' is shown.
